en.title: Die Zeit reports on Trump and Huang friendship
en.dek: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia leadership; Die Zeit covers his relationship with Donald Trump.
facts: Die Zeit published an article on November 26, 2026 about Jensen Huang and Donald Trump.
The article's title is 'Amerikas wahre Elite' (America's true elite).
Jensen Huang is the chief executive of Nvidia.
Die Zeit discusses the friendship between Trump and Huang in a US podcast.
body: Die Zeit published an article on November 26, 2026 about Jensen Huang and Donald Trump.
The article's title is 'Amerikas wahre Elite'.
Jensen Huang returned to the top leadership of Nvidia.
Die Zeit discusses the friendship between Trump and Huang in a US podcast.
en.context: Jensen Huang is the chief executive of Nvidia, a major designer of semiconductor chips. Die Zeit published an article on November 26, 2026 examining the relationship between Trump and Huang.

pt.context: Jensen Huang é o diretor executivo da Nvidia, um grande designer de semicondutores. Die Zeit publicou um artigo em 26 de novembro de 2026 a examinar a relação entre Trump e Huang.

problemsFixed: Headline exceeds 90 characters and uses 'meets' which implies a current event rather than a past meeting described in sources.

Facts contain unsupported claims: 'Huang met with US President-elect Donald Trump at Mar-a-Lago' — sources state they were described as 'Amerikas wahre Elite' but do not confirm a meeting at Mar-a-Lago or that Trump is 'President-elect' in November 2026 (sources say Die Zeit article is dated 2026-11-26, but do not specify Trump's title).

Facts attribute claims to sources that are not in the text: 'Die Zeit discussed the nature of the men's friendship in a US podcast' — source says 'wir diskutieren im US-Podcast' (we discuss in US podcast), but does not state this as a fact about the article's content beyond the tag.
Body repeats the inaccessible Spiegel article claim about therapy sessions without attribution to a named source within the available text.
Body states 'Der Spiegel published an article questioning what Huang had gotten wrong' — source S2 is paywalled/unavailable; content cannot be verified.

Body states 'Die Zeit framed the relationship... as a discussion of America's true elite' — source says the title is 'Amerikas wahre Elite' but does not say the relationship was 'framed' as such beyond the title.
Body ends paragraphs with evaluative summaries ('limiting the specific claims that can be reported').
Paragraphs open with repeated noun 'The' (sentences 1 and 2 body).
Sentence rhythm: multiple short declarative sentences in a row without longer clauses.
Context contains unsupported claim: 'Donald Trump is the US President-elect as of November 2026' — not in sources.
